symptom: A describe translations file for Workflow Commons, filled in and run back with create or modify translations, reported every CRLF source ("{1} days\r\n", the confirmation questions) as 'No text has … as its source', and CE4899 stayed.
file: mdl/translations/project.go Dictionary.matcher / lookup (used by Apply, PatchUnit, OutOfScope). Test: mdl/translations/line_endings_2383_test.go
cause: Sources were matched byte for byte. describe writes the CR raw inside the quoted string (verified on current main: 8 CR lines for WorkflowCommons), but any editor, agent or git checkout that normalises line endings turns the file's sources into LF, which then matched nothing.
insight: **A key that survives only byte-exact transport will not survive an agent's edit.** The round trip worked when the file was untouched, so the defect was not in describe; the reporter's step 'fill in a translation' was. Match with line endings ignored (exact first), and write the translation with the source's CRLF so Studio Pro stores what it would. Measured on 11.12.6: a CR-stripped file sets {1} Tage in both documents, stored as {1} Tage\r\n.
